name: Natsuhara Orie
source:
She fidgets as she is looking for something. She lost something important and is searching for it, but just cant remember what it is.
She is a strange girl who just doesn't understand.

Her behavior lacks an ounce of common sense, which often causes trouble for Yuu.

[From [url=http://www.t-apricot.jp/products/aya/chara.html]ApRicoT[/url]]
